title: Burglary Deductible Base on Reconsidered Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan Claims
content:
On a reconsideration of a Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan claim, the deductible charged is taken from the deductible base of the reconsideration. The deductible base of the reconsideration is the level's deductible, except that for a burglary claim on a unit whose class has drive-up access it is 10 percent of the settled total, and for a burglary claim on a unit whose class has no drive-up access it is 5 percent of the settled total, in both burglary situations never less than the level's deductible.

| Claim | Covered unit class (Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement) | Deductible base |
| --- | --- | --- |
| burglary | drive-up access | 10 percent of the settled total, at least the level's deductible |
| burglary | no drive-up access | 5 percent of the settled total, at least the level's deductible |
| other peril | any | the level's deductible |

**Q. Which settled total is meant?** The settled total of the reconsideration itself, from the latest adjuster assessment.

**Q. Worked figures (hypothetical).** Burglary in a drive-up unit with a settled total of 1,800.00 and a level deductible of 100.00: 10 percent is 180.00, so the base is 180.00. In an interior unit: 5 percent is 90.00, so the base is 100.00.
